CoverageObservation.description: Machine-readable source/capability status; absence never becomes a negative claim.
CoverageObservation.title: CoverageObservation

DerivedRevenueShare.description:
A conservative analytic grouping over retained report observations.

The printed revenue row remains the primary observation.  This records the
numerator, denominator and formula needed to show a share without narrowing
a mixed source label or treating the result as another source fact.
DerivedRevenueShare.title: DerivedRevenueShare

ExternalIdentifier.description: An identifier issued by an external system, never the CauseBase primary key.
ExternalIdentifier.title: ExternalIdentifier

FinancialLineItem.description: A selectively preserved report line, retaining its source label.
FinancialLineItem.title: FinancialLineItem

FinancialStatementObservation.description: A source-faithful financial statement, separate from headline metrics.
FinancialStatementObservation.title: FinancialStatementObservation

FinancialStatementRow.description: A printed statement row retained before optional canonical projection.
FinancialStatementRow.title: FinancialStatementRow

FunctionalExpenseAllocation.description:
A source-reported functional allocation, kept separate from a P&L row.

Charts frequently report a share of independently reported total expenses.
The share is the direct observation; an amount is only a transparent
deterministic projection and must never be presented as another report row.
FunctionalExpenseAllocation.title: FunctionalExpenseAllocation

MoneyObservation.description: A directly observed amount with source fidelity and exact normalisation.
MoneyObservation.title: MoneyObservation

NavigationGeography.description: Small controlled geography projection used only for navigation.
NavigationGeography.title: NavigationGeography

ParticipationObservation.description: A stable public participation path, distinct from a dated opportunity.
ParticipationObservation.title: ParticipationObservation

ProgramObservation.description: An evidence-bound program nested under an organisation unless separately governed.
ProgramObservation.title: ProgramObservation

RevenueShareComponent.description: One source-preserved revenue row included in an analytic grouping.
RevenueShareComponent.title: RevenueShareComponent

SourceNativeRecord.description:
A public-safe, source-specific observation, never a universal claim.

The record retains source field names and time independently of the
canonical card. Large raw archives and copyrighted documents remain private.
SourceNativeRecord.title: SourceNativeRecord

SourceResolution.description: A source-record-to-subject resolution; uncertainty is a valid persisted state.
SourceResolution.title: SourceResolution

StructuredValueObservation.description: A display/navigation value with provenance separate from its wording.
StructuredValueObservation.title: StructuredValueObservation

SynthesisMetadata.description:
Reproducibility metadata for an evidence-grounded LLM artefact.

Prompts and raw source excerpts are deliberately excluded from the public
card: they are private working material. The stable identifiers and hashes
make an artefact auditable without publishing copied third-party text.
SynthesisMetadata.title: SynthesisMetadata

TaxonomyAmbiguity.description: A private signal that two or more supplied terms were hard to distinguish.
TaxonomyAmbiguity.title: TaxonomyAmbiguity

UnmappedConcept.description:
A private signal that supplied taxonomy terms did not fit cleanly.

It is deliberately not a classification and cannot introduce a term ID.
The field is excluded from public card serialisation; periodic taxonomy
review is the governed route from these observations to a proposal.
UnmappedConcept.title: UnmappedConcept
